rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the arm joint.

example.english: I banged my elbow on the corner of the table, and it really hurts.
example.traditional: 我個手踭撞到枱角，好痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 sau2 zaang1 zong6 dou2 toi4 gok3 hou2 tung3

rows.note: Use this for a bend or angular section in a wall, building, coastline, or similar structure.

example.english: There is an elbow bend in the street here, so drive more slowly.
example.traditional: 呢度係條街嘅彎位，揸車要慢啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 tiu4 gaai1 ge3 waan1 wai2 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 maan6 di1

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate strike made with the elbow, especially in martial-arts or fighting contexts.

example.english: During the match, they hit their opponent with an elbow strike.
example.traditional: 比賽嗰陣，佢一記肘擊打中對手。
example.jyutping: bei2 coi3 go2 zan6 keoi5 jat1 gei3 zau2 gik1 daa2 zung3 deoi3 sau2
